teaser.en: A wild, aromatic lantana that Digo count as the 'male' partner of a ground-covering vernonia.
teaser.sw: Lantana ya porini yenye harufu, ambayo Wadigo huihesabu kuwa mwenzi 'dume' wa vernonia inayofunika ardhi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu nono, cha jenasi ya *Lantana*, ambacho Adigo anachiona dza 'mlume' wa *vernonia* inayofwinika tsi.

summary.en: *Chiphatsa chilume* is an aromatic wild lantana of dry bushland. Digo pair it with the vernonia called *chiphatsa*, as its male form.
summary.sw: *Chiphatsa chilume* ni lantana ya porini yenye harufu, ya vichaka vikavu. Wadigo huiunganisha na vernonia inayoitwa *chiphatsa*, kama umbo lake la dume.
summary.dg: *Chiphatsa chilume* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu nono, cha jenasi ya *Lantana*, chinachomera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu. Adigo anachiika phamwenga na *vernonia* inayoihwa *chiphatsa*, na anachiona kukala ni *chiphatsa* cha chilume.

about.en: *Lantana viburnoides* is a much-branched, aromatic shrub with rough, toothed leaves that smell when crushed. Its small white, pink or lilac flowers grow in tight, rounded heads, and its small fleshy fruits ripen purple. Unlike the invasive *Lantana camara*, it has no prickles and is native to Africa. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Lantana viburnoides* ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi na harufu, chenye majani yenye kukwaruza na meno, yanayonukia yanapopondwa. Maua yake madogo meupe, ya waridi au ya zambarau hafifu huota katika vichwa vilivyobanana vya mviringo, na matunda yake madogo yenye nyama huiva yakawa ya zambarau. Tofauti na *Lantana camara* inayovamia, haina miiba na ni ya asili ya Afrika. Wadigo huitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Lantana viburnoides* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji na arufu nono. Makodzage ganakaraza, gana meno kanda-kanda, na ganalavya arufu gachihopezwa. Maruwage madide, ga rangi nyereru, ga pinki au ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu, ganamera phamwenga ganabanana kukala vitswa vya mviringo, na matundage madide genye nyama ganakala ga zambarau ganaphoivwa. Tafwauti na *Lantana camara*, inayoenea kpwa nguvu, chitsaka hichi tachina miya, na ni cha chienyeji cha Afrika. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and wooded grassland in East Africa and Arabia.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, vichaka vizito na nyika za nyasi zenye miti katika Afrika Mashariki na Uarabuni.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu, vitsakani na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi, Afrika ya Mashariki na Uarabuni.

names.en: *Chiphatsa chilume* means 'male chiphatsa'. *Chiphatsa* or *phatsa* is *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, named because it covers the ground like a roof (*kuphatsa*, to roof). Digo count this lantana as the male form of the unmarked *chiphatsa*. Its relative, the invasive *Lantana camara*, is *mjasasa* in northern Digo and *mtsambala* in southern Digo, and *mshomoro* is shared by all Digo.
names.sw: *Chiphatsa chilume* maana yake ni '*chiphatsa* dume'. *Chiphatsa* au *phatsa* ni *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, iliyopewa jina hilo kwa sababu hufunika ardhi kama paa (*kuphatsa*, kuezeka). Wadigo huihesabu lantana hii kuwa umbo la dume la *chiphatsa* isiyo na kiambishi cha jinsia. Jamaa yake, *Lantana camara* inayovamia, ni *mjasasa* kwa Kidigo cha kaskazini na *mtsambala* kwa Kidigo cha kusini, na *mshomoro* linatumiwa na Wadigo wote.
names.dg: *Chiphatsa chilume* manage ni '*chiphatsa* cha chilume'. *Chiphatsa* au *phatsa* ni *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, na yaihwa vivyo kpwa sababu inafwinika tsi dza nyumba iriyoezekpwa (*kuphatsa*, 'kuezeka'). Adigo anaiona *lantana* hino kukala ni aina ya chilume ya *chiphatsa*, ambacho dzinare tarina neno ranjina. Nduguye, *Lantana camara* inayoenea kpwa nguvu, inaihwa *mjasasa* ni Adigo a kazikazini na *mtsambala* ni Adigo a kusini, na dzina *mshomoro* ni ra Adigo osi.

reason.dg: *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, ambayo Adigo anaiona kukala ni ya chichetu
